scenario: An immutable JSON baseline and one approved field replacement are supplied.
must: hash the exact baseline
encode the target, expected old value, approved new value, invariants, and rebuild scope
create a new candidate version
verify exact baseline-plus-delta equality
must_not: claim success without a diff report

scenario: One approved slide caption changes while all other source and media assets are invariant.
must: apply the change to canonical source
reuse unaffected artifacts byte-for-byte when the format permits
rebuild only affected dependencies
run format-specific layout and reference checks
must_not: edit the exported delivery as source

scenario: A locked workbook cell value changes under a stable table key.
must: use stable cell or table identity
compare formula, value, and style state proportionately
recalculate and check error cells
preserve the previous release

scenario: The exact candidate passes the declared semantic diff and format gates.
must: generate the report from validator data
create a hash-based release manifest
report new paths and preserved invariants
advance a current-version pointer only after all gates pass

scenario: No authoritative baseline artifact or release can be resolved.
must: stop before mutation
state which baseline evidence is missing
request the canonical file or exact release

scenario: The delta's expected old value differs from the baseline.
must: fail closed on the stale assumption
report the exact target and mismatch
require a regenerated or reapproved delta

scenario: The candidate contains one undeclared semantic change.
must: fail the allowed-diff gate
identify the undeclared path or object
keep the prior release current
must_not: average the result into a pass

scenario: A declared change is absent from the candidate.
must: fail the semantic gate
report the missing declared operation
leave the baseline and current pointer intact
must_not: alter the declaration after the fact

scenario: A referenced invariant or required file is missing.
must: fail the relevant gate
name the missing file and affected proof
preserve recoverability

scenario: A user requests overwriting the approved baseline to avoid another version.
must: refuse in-place baseline mutation
create a distinct candidate path
keep the old release recoverable
must_not: rename the candidate as the old release

scenario: A renderer offers to rewrite or improve approved copy during export.
must: keep approved content authoritative
prevent renderer improvisation
surface any unavoidable transformation in the diff
must_not: treat generated output as canonical source

scenario: A report says nothing else changed but provides no mechanical evidence.
must: reject the unsupported claim
require the allowed-diff report and applicable hashes or probes
label skipped checks honestly

scenario: An intentional repeated asset would be flagged by a duplicate detector.
must: require an explicit scoped allowlist
retain evidence for the exception
keep unrelated duplicate findings active

scenario: A locked document revision needs Word-specific tracked changes and layout verification.
must: retain locked-revision as the delta and non-regression controller
hand document mechanics to the document producer
combine semantic and rendered checks
return one evidence-backed handoff
must_not: let the producer widen the delta

scenario: A final video copy correction requires a segment rebuild.
must: retain integer frame boundaries as canonical units
hand rendering to the video pipeline after semantic approval
rebuild only affected closed segments when feasible
verify timing, media identity, and output probes
must_not: use display seconds as sole authority

scenario: The request combines one exact correction with a broad redesign.
must: separate the surgical delta from the new design request
resolve which outcome is authorized before mutation
route broad design to its owner as a separate version or task
must_not: smuggle redesign into the allowed diff
